{{Quote|The entire crew? Is it that bad?.|Unidentified customs official|<ref name="CoD" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Customs official/Legends|customs official]] who served in the [[Eriadu Customs and Immigration]].<ref name="CoD" /> In [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]],<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> the customs official and the rest of the team were aboard a [[picket ship]] in orbit around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. They sent an inspection team to board a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] for a routine check. Unbeknownst to the team, the [[Arwen Cohl's freighter|freighter's]] occupants were [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] aligned with the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]]. The mercenaries were tasked with assassinating [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] during the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]] being held on the planet.<ref name="CoD" />

[[Rella]], leading the team of mercenaries, forced the inspection team's [[Unidentified female chief customs inspector|chief inspector]] to order a larger inspection team from the picket ship to board the freighter, allowing the mercenaries to capture the inspection team and their [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. The customs official and the rest of his team were then tied up and secured in the aft hold of the freighter. They were later discovered and rescued after an anonymous tip was given to Eriadu security.<ref name="CoD" />
